text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (May 13, 2025) for 11 Churchill Avenue

The Property Standards Committee – North York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (May 13, 2025) for 11 Churchill Avenue, Folder Number 25 157981 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to September 30, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
